title: 02章、惊变伊始天地乱
lines: 不仅仅是法力的弥补，伴随着这突如其来的法力精元，张荼发现自己的身体也是开始发生着变化。内视可以发现，自己的五脏六腑似是也得到了滋养，闪烁着淡淡的光辉。而自己骨骼的密度，也越来越大；自己的肌肤除了肤色没有变化之外，竟是变得愈加的滑嫩，甚至闪烁着晶莹的光泽。
体质的不断提升，所带来的可不仅仅只是恢复那般简单，如今体质还能够提升，那只能说是在发生质的变化，超越了以往多多，使得体质更上一层楼。
此时此刻，张荼感觉自己的每一寸肌肤都充满了爆炸性的力量，感觉自己可以跟妖修厮杀之时，不动用相思，都可以进行一场硬碰硬的对决。
当张荼幽幽醒转之时，发现战场之上的熊熊烈火早已经熄灭，而且原本的参天巨木也在炮火和法力的夹击之下，变得空荡荡的，恍若一片饱受蹂躏的平原。不用升空张荼也知道，此刻的木源城外，那恍若碧玉的毯子，又被人烫了几个丑陋的烟洞。
扭头看见子矜和裹成木乃伊一般的秦风站在自己身后的不远处，默默地守护着，在更远处，可以看到徐林带着一些伤痕累累的B级修士在警戒着。
笑了笑，随后抬头仰望无尽虚无的天空，默默地沉思着。今日的木源城因为自己等人的缘故，有惊无险地守住了，但是其他城池呢？张荼不知道，但是他知道仅凭借自己一个人，是无力守护整个九州。
不过，这并不是让他气馁的理由，路都是一步步走出来的。毕竟弱小是必经的过程，而且对于长春功的明悟以及串联起来轮回海，张荼发现了一个自己忽略的事情。
异域征伐，是真实存在的么？
若是真实存在，自己等人无异于是轮回一场，可是若不是真实存在，谢夕岚等人的真实经验又是从何而来。若是有人可以逆转时空，将自己等人毫无知觉地彻底打回孩提时代，同时封印了所有的记忆，在特定的情况之下才可
这种手段，多少有些匪夷所思，怕是天道也做不到，因为这种手段已经违背了天道的基本规则，除非进行一场大破灭，万物灭绝的混乱时期，才可以如此的为所欲为，但是如今的九州明显是未曾经历这种浩劫。
别说普通人了，就是强如一品，也绝无可能在世界的大破灭之中生存。毕竟，如今超过一品的手段势必会刺激到沉睡的天道，所以一切就好似进入了一个无解的循环之中，或许边关月可以给自己一个解释。
如今的木源城中，多少有些冷清和死寂，毕竟中青一代的不少人都已经永远的埋骨在了城外的战场之上。如今的妖祸，对于无数拥有了新的力量的中青年来说，或许中年男人心中武侠梦的侠义精神，又或者是青年心中保家卫国的热血精神。
也可能更多人是在变强，是在追梦，追逐理想，或许有些以偏概全，但是有不少人却是如此，就这么一去不回地倒在了木源城外。
入城的过程中，张荼看到一个个热切的脸庞，有酒楼中吃最后一顿酒的熟悉人影，也有那夜篝火晚会中的热血少年，可是他们每一个人的脸上，都带着悲痛和不甘，又夹杂着击退妖祸的开心喜悦。
content_zh:
一切都如同张荼所预料的那样，自己离职的消息终归是在这一方小池塘之中激起了阵阵涟漪。

    “张老师，为什么啊。”

    “那群废物，凭什么？淦！”

    暴躁的张守学，满脸的义愤填膺，恨不得对着那些他眼中的高层们邦邦两记重拳。

    “没有为什么，可能就是与公司发展战略不符吧，毕竟团队之中，没有不可以代替的人物，不是么？好啦，没什么事儿的，等我回头请你们吃饭。”

    张荼笑着看着眼前几位喜怒溢于言表的年轻人，尤其是那喜怒写在面上的张守学。呵，年轻真好，当初的自己也是这么的……这么的古道热肠。

    此时，一位身材高挑的女子径直走了过来，原本义愤的张守学看到来人，脸上不由得对着张荼露出一丝促狭的笑容。

    女子看到张荼正收拾东西，声音不咸不淡地说道：“真准备走啊。”

    “对啊，这不是公司通知都下了么。”张荼抬头看着眼前的女子，样貌说不上特别好看，但是相当的耐看，笑着说道：“不过也正好休息一段时间。”

    女子笑着问道：“怎么，打算抛下我？”

    张荼略微头痛地看着眼前的女子，歪歪头，心中百转千回，眼前的这位不是别人，正是自己当初的老同学云裳，平时性情清淡，不苟言笑，唯独面对着自己的时候才会不惜笑靥，丝毫没有对待外人那般的冷淡清霜。

    不过张荼也不能保证自己就是唯一的例外，不过在张荼的世界里，云裳一直是这个模样。

    而且，梦境之中一直有一个女子始终在回荡，虽然样貌一直看不真切，但是张荼下意识的认定，那个人就是云裳。

    可是梦境里，所有的一切都与现实并不相同。

    是，前世么？

    在现实中，二人乃是相识十多年的老同学了，不大不小的城市之中，他应该是云裳唯一的例外。

    不过有一点，张荼漂泊数年才归家，而云裳一直留驻在这个小城市中，不过如今的她，也算是有了一个不错的归宿，不过是尚未结婚罢了。

    而那时，云裳曾经逼问过他，不过他放荡不羁爱自由地痴迷于另外一个同样惊艳的女子，一口回绝，这也是他为之抱憾多年的决定。

    不过尽管如此，在张荼回来之后，就如在这里入职一般，他前脚入职，云裳后脚便来面试，而她对张荼的特殊待遇，也致使公司内部各种流言蜚语四起，各种故事版本复杂多样。

    不过张荼也从来都不会去选择解释什么，无非是人都有黑暗的恶趣味，重或者轻罢了，而两个人的状态又在常人的眼中颇为禁忌，因此更激发了他们的创作欲望。

    不过玩归玩，闹归闹，二人从不拿感情开玩笑。

    顶多有时候为了看到张荼的狼狈模样，甚至不惜出卖一些色相，例如张荼跟别人浓情蜜意的时候，会突如其来一些艳照。

    用她的话说就是，反正你想看当年就能看，如今你已是身经百战，这些对你来说又算得了什么呢？

    不过能够想象到你睡沙发的样子，也是不错的，当然要是再跪跪键盘，那当真是极好的。
content_en:
Everything was as Zhang Tu expected, and the news of his resignation finally caused ripples in this small pond.

"Teacher Zhang, why?"

"Those losers, why? Gan!"

The irritable Zhang Shouxue, his face filled with righteous indignation, wanted to punch those high-ranking officials in his eyes twice.

"There's no reason. Maybe it's not in line with the company's development strategy. After all, there's no irreplaceable person in the team, right? Okay, it's okay. I'll treat you to dinner later."

Zhang Tu smiled and looked at the several young people in front of him who were full of joy and anger, especially Zhang Shouxue who had joy and anger written on his face.Oh, it's great to be young. I was also like this back then... so old-fashioned and warm-hearted.

At this time, a tall woman walked straight over. Zhang Shouxue, who was originally indignant, couldn't help but show a narrow smile to Zhang Tu when he saw the person.

When the woman saw Zhang Tu packing his things, she said in a nonchalant voice, "I'm really ready to leave."

"Yes, isn't the notice from the company issued?" Zhang Tu looked up at the woman in front of him. Her appearance was not particularly good-looking, but she was quite attractive. She smiled and said, "But it's just a good time to rest."

The woman smiled and asked, "What, are you planning to leave me?"

Zhang Tu looked at the woman in front of him with a slight headache, tilted his head, and thought a thousand times. The person in front of him was none other than his old classmate Yun Shang. He usually had a light temperament and was unsmiling. He only smiled when facing himself, and did not treat outsiders with the same indifference.

However, Zhang Tu can't guarantee that he is the only exception, but in Zhang Tu's world, Yun Shang has always looked like this.

Moreover, there was always a woman echoing in the dream. Although her appearance was never clear, Zhang Tu subconsciously determined that that person was Yun Shang.

But in dreams, everything is different from reality.

Yes, past life?

In reality, the two are old classmates who have known each other for more than ten years. In a city of any size, he should be the only exception for Yun Shang.

But there is one thing. Zhang Tu wandered for several years before returning home, and Yunshang has always stayed in this small city. But now, she can be considered to have a good home, but she is not married yet.

At that time, Yun Shang once pressed him, but he was unrestrained and free to be obsessed with another equally stunning woman, so he refused. This was a decision that he had regretted for many years.

But despite this, after Zhang Tu came back, it was like joining here. He joined the company first, and Yun Shang came for the interview. Her special treatment of Zhang Tu also caused various rumors to spread within the company, and the various versions of the stories were complex and diverse.

However, Zhang Tu never chooses to explain anything. It's just that people have dark and evil tastes, whether they are serious or light, and the state of the two people is quite taboo in the eyes of ordinary people, which further stimulates their desire to create.

However, the two of them never joked about their feelings.

At most, sometimes in order to see Zhang Tu's embarrassed appearance, he would even betray some of his looks. For example, when Zhang Tu was deeply in love with others, he would suddenly take some nude photos.

In her words, you could have watched it back then if you wanted to. Now that you have experienced hundreds of battles, what does this mean to you?

But it’s also nice to be able to imagine you sleeping on the sofa. Of course, it would be really great if you can kneel down on the keyboard.
